component.name: OpenBand
component.summary: A music studio that you — or your AI — can play
Uno studio musicale che puoi suonare tu, o la tua AI

description.p: OpenBand is a free, open-source music studio (DAW): instruments, drums, audio tracks, effects, mixing and mastering, each step a gesture instead of a manual.

ul.li: Play with a MIDI keyboard, record your voice or instrument, and arrange the song in sections
Mix and master in one gesture, for every streaming platform
Load the CLAP and VST3 plugins you already have
Any AI can play it too, through MCP: Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Hermes or a local model
Release your song with a Creative Commons licence, a cover and a video

description.p: OpenBand è uno studio musicale (DAW) libero e open source: strumenti, batteria, tracce audio, effetti, mix e master, ogni passo un gesto invece di un manuale.
